text: Starting: shift-constrained axis drag for node dragging. Investigating beginNodeDrag, moveSelectedNodes, dragWindowHandlers.onMouseMove, and the alt-copy live-modifier template in JavaScript/braindump.js.

Done. Patch built (7 hunks) for shift-constrained node dragging, verified via page.route serving a patched scratch copy (never touched the real braindump.js). All 9 cases in the new tests/board/shift-constrained-drag.test.mjs pass against the patch and fail against the unpatched file (case A fails first: got x=800 raw, expected ~804.14 snapped). No regression: board-shift-snap-runtime (12/12), board-shift-snap-no-history-spam, board-shift-snap-stroke-e2e (5/5), embed-pointer-and-fullscreen (8/8), and youtube-url-and-resume (8/8) all pass against the patched build via an isolated scratch clone. Full patch + report handed to orchestrator.
